items.title: 56706_Buddy Tate oral history interview
items.q: Because he'd been my friend all the time.

ctx.x: So after about 30, 35 minutes later, everybody in

the band stood up but Prez, you know, and that was kind of bugging me. I said, "Maybe he didn't like that, you know. I wonder why." Because he'd been my friend all the time. After everybody was playing and everything, Keye looked behind the reed section and he said, --
